title: Size bound for the exactly-three-CNF encoding
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $n$ input bits and $g$ gates. The number of clauses in its exactly-three-CNF encoding is at most $8(3g+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean circuit with input dimension n
